documentation_accuracy.dispute_reason: Scope defect (ZYLCODE_CAPABILITY_MODEL.md 3.1/3.2). The capability name implies broad documentation accuracy; the evidence string only covers repo-URL references. The 2026-09-16 README review found further inaccuracies: a removed-as-unsupported '156 tools' claim had reappeared, 'Total: 32 tests passing' understated 341 test attributes and omitted a failure, three doc links pointed at files that have never existed, and the README defined an R0-R5 ladder contradicting ZYLCODE_PROOF_GRAPH.md. Requires re-verification against a stated scope.

repository_scanner.evidence: Scanner indexes 14,973 files in 12.7s with .gitignore and secret-file exclusion
repository_scanner.details: Deterministic file tree walker with language/role classification, content hashing, and Windows path support
repository_scanner.dispute_reason: Phase 2A NOT ACCEPTED (independent audit, 2026-09-16). Recorded GREEN on the basis of unit tests and a benchmark that fails on re-execution. The subsystem has no product entry point, so by ZYLCODE_PROOF_GRAPH.md 2.1 it is R2 (a library), not R3 (a capability). Not re-baselined here: re-baselining is remediation item P0.2/P0.6. METRIC DEFECT: 'indexes 14,973 files' counted target/ build output. Measured: 15,064 indexed of which 14,900 are under target/ (98.9%). The repository is 254 files (git ls-files = 193). Root cause: should_exclude() matches forward-slash patterns against Windows backslash paths, so the exclusion list is dead code on the primary target platform. Also: benchmark asserts only file_count() > 50, and the reported scan time (12.7s) does not reproduce (276.1s measured, assertion FAILS).
